review_scope: 23 paired installed V2 surface views against the current main publication. Review covers material continuity and visible breakage.

images.observation: Floorboards, stove and dining furniture retain their fitted surfaces; companion expression differs.
Tile joints and fabric keep their definition in the same flashlight position.
Resident, furniture, radiator and floor remain present with coherent surfaces.
Wood grain, trim and window light remain readable. Companion expression changed.
Cabinet, sink, wall and floor remain intact. A subtitle appears in the candidate.
Boiler face, exposed fittings and grounding shadow match the prior framing.
Shelf and book silhouettes, lacquer and room threshold remain intact.
Tile joints and service fitting remain visible; candidate ambient intensity varies.
Dark brick retains the same mortar relief and grading.
Fuse sockets, conduit and housing remain distinct; door lighting varies.
Floor tiles, rail, shelf and under-counter prop retain coherent material separation.
Portrait, small shelf prop and wood lip remain visible at the same exposure.
Ceiling, brackets and framed art remain intact under the same accent light.
Mailbox doors, labels, wood and bench remain visible at the same composition.
Cast iron ribs, wall, folded fabric and wood table retain their surfaces.
Roof landing, rail, sign and wall trim remain intact.
Tank shell, supports and surrounding roofing retain the same material separation.
Terminal glows over the same floorboards. Wall and board shading vary slightly.
Grout remains aligned and bracket edges are present; ambient fill is lighter.
Iridescent residue and surrounding threshold remain readable.
Creature and iron ribs remain coherent; background fill is brighter in the candidate.
Toaster, crumbs and kettle remain distinct on the counter; the light catches the toaster differently.
Station plate, keyway and metal hardware remain intact; hardware picks up a stronger highlight.
